mapper.select: SELECT config::text AS configJson, config_version AS configVersion, updated_by AS updatedBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, enabled FROM public.chat_audit_config WHERE singleton = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.chat_audit_config (singleton, enabled, config, config_version, updated_by) VALUES (TRUE, #{enabled}, #{configJson}::jsonb, 1, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (singleton) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, config = EXCLUDED.config, config_version = chat_audit_config.config_version + 1, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = now()
